fullPassage: Dear Residents, I am Trixie Mitchell, the director of the Riverside Community Center. I am pleased to invite you to a book donation drive. We are collecting used books to support our reading programs for children and teenagers. By donating books, you can help young readers discover the joy of reading. Any books in good condition are gladly accepted, including novels, poetry, and non-fiction books. You can bring your books to our community center during our operating hours. We would be grateful if you could join this meaningful event. Sincerely, Trixie Mitchell

questions.passage: Dear Residents, I am Trixie Mitchell, the director of the Riverside Community Center. I am (A)[pleased / annoyed] to invite you to a book donation drive. We are collecting used books to (B)[support / collecting] our reading programs for children and teenagers. By donating books, you can help young readers discover the joy of reading. Any books in good condition are gladly accepted, including novels, poetry, and non-fiction books. You can bring your books to our community center during our operating hours. We would be grateful if you could join this (C)[meaningful / trivial] event. Sincerely, Trixie Mitchell
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 기뻐하며(pleased) 초대, 독서 프로그램을 지원(support), 의미 있는(meaningful) 행사.
det.analysis:
✅ ② pleased — support — meaningful: 원문 일치
❌ ① collecting(수집하는): support가 원문
❌ ③ annoyed(짜증난): pleased 반의어
❌ ④ trivial(사소한): meaningful 반의어

questions.passage: Dear Residents, I am Trixie Mitchell, the director of the Riverside Community Center. I am pleased to (A)[invite / reject] you to a book donation drive. We are collecting used books to support our reading programs for children and teenagers. By donating books, you can help young readers (B)[discover / overlook] the joy of reading. Any books in good condition are gladly accepted, including novels, poetry, and non-fiction books. You can bring your books to our community center during our (C)[operating / closing] hours. We would be grateful if you could join this meaningful event. Sincerely, Trixie Mitchell
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 초대(invite), 읽기의 즐거움을 발견(discover), 운영(operating) 시간.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ invite — discover — operating: 원문 일치
❌ ① overlook(간과하다): discover 반의어
❌ ② reject(거절하다): invite 반의어
❌ ④ closing(폐점하는): operating 반의어

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 기부(donation) 행사, 기꺼이(gladly) 받음, 감사하는(grateful).
det.analysis:
✅ ① donation — gladly — grateful: 원문 일치
❌ ② reluctantly(마지못해): gladly 반의어
❌ ③ refusal(거절): donation과 반대 의미
❌ ④ resentful(원망하는): grateful 반의어

questions.passage: Dear Residents, I am Trixie Mitchell, the ①<u>director</u> of the Riverside Community Center. I am pleased to ②<u>invite</u> you to a book donation drive. We are collecting used books to ③<u>support</u> our reading programs for children and teenagers. By donating books, you can help young readers discover the joy of reading. Any books in good condition are gladly accepted, including novels, poetry, and non-fiction books. You can bring your books to our community center during our operating hours. We would be grateful if you could join this ④<u>harmful</u> event. Sincerely, Trixie Mitchell
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ harmful(해로운)은 원문 meaningful(의미 있는)의 반의어. '의미 있는' 행사에 참여 요청.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ harmful(해로운): 원문 meaningful(의미 있는)의 반의어. 이 행사는 의미 있는 것이지 해로운 것이 아니다.
✅ ① director(관장): 원문 일치 — 커뮤니티 센터의 관장
✅ ② invite(초대하다): 원문 일치 — 주민들을 초대
✅ ③ support(지원하다): 원문 일치 — 독서 프로그램 지원

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 낱말 중 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② hinder(방해하다)는 원문 support(지원하다)의 반의어. 독서 프로그램을 '지원'해야 함.
det.analysis:
❌ ② hinder(방해하다): 원문 support(지원하다)의 반의어. 독서 프로그램을 지원해야 하는데 방해한다는 것은 문맥에 맞지 않는다.
✅ ① collecting(수집하는): 원문 일치 — 중고 책을 수집하는 문맥
✅ ③ condition(상태): 원문 일치 — 양호한 상태의 책
✅ ④ grateful(감사하는): 원문 일치 — 참여에 감사

✅ ② donating(기부하는): 원문 일치 — 책을 기부함으로써
